paragraphs.text: Wernog , Rider's Chaplain , is a legendary human from Innistrad .

Wernog is a human chaplain of the Gavony Riders of the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad . The Riders are the elite cavalry of Innistrad, extensively trained in mounted combat with swords and lances. He is a light-skinned male who wears the white uniform of the Church. He wields a staff ending in the symbol of Avacyn, various large scrolls on his back, and a magic lantern that appears to dispel darkness. The symbol of Avacyn can be seen glowing on his forehead.
